Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 25 Oct 2004 16:30:32 -0700, fina...@hotmail.com (ThE_OnLy_VipeR)
wrote:

>Can i play Gangrel Justicar on a Independent Gangrel like Xavier or
>Zayyat, etc.???

No.

Only Camarilla vampires can become Justicars.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/

Section 10.1

>because the card says choose a ready gangrel but nowhere it says it
>must be camarilla. but i believe that the card turns the vampire into
>camarilla

The rules are clear so that the card needn't be.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec10_1

"Only Camarilla vampires can be primogen, princes, justicars or Inner
Circle members. Additionally, clan justicar titles can only be held by
a vampire of the appropriate clan. "

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com
